statement: For common positive directed stationary-flow cycle architecture,pointwise UNNORMALIZED log-weight erroru and cycle-flow log-errorv give the root source bound |log(Mhat/M)|<=3u+K*v (sharper factor exp(3u)*exp(2asinh(K*sinh(v/2)))). Weights/flows use the SAME gauge,w(all-zero)=1 in the model. Killed directed M-matrix positivity yields M=w_B^T D_B^-1 w_B/sum_Bw:two RHS weights and one normalizer cost exp(±3u). The independent computation note reconstructs this weight factor and a separately controlled-flow form bound;its weaker eps<1 expression is not silently relabeled as a whole audit of every sharp root refinement. No common-pi theorem can be reused after changing weights without this argument.
